function checkoutResult({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,sessionId}) {if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||bodyEncoding!=null||!body||typeof body!=='object'||Array.isArray(body)||body.id!==sessionId)throw Error('Stripe did not return the requested Checkout Session');const details=body.customer_details;if(details!=null&&(typeof details!=='object'||Array.isArray(details)))throw Error('Invalid customer details');const rows=body.line_items?.data;if(!Array.isArray(rows))throw Error('Expanded line items are missing');const text=(v)=>{if(v==null)return null;if(typeof v!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Checkout Session field');return v};return {customerName:text(details?.name),customerEmail:text(details?.email),productDescription:text(rows[0]?.description)};}

return {json:checkoutResult({body:$json,statusCode:200,bodyEncoding:null,sessionId:$('Select Checkout Session').first().json.sessionId})};

function checkoutRequest({body,eventId}) {if(body?.type!=='checkout.session.completed'||body.id!==eventId||typeof eventId!=='string'||!eventId)throw Error('Invalid Stripe event');const sessionId=body.data?.object?.id;if(typeof sessionId!=='string'||!/^cs_(?:test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(sessionId))throw Error('Invalid Checkout Session ID');return {sessionId,endpoint:'/v1/checkout/sessions/'+encodeURIComponent(sessionId)};}

return {json:checkoutRequest({body:$json,eventId:$json.id})};
